name: io.getunleash/unleash-mcp
description: MCP server for Unleash: an AI-agent-friendly interface to Unleash

environmentVariables.description: Your Unleash instance URL (local or hosted)
environmentVariables.name: UNLEASH_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Your Unleash Personal Access Token (PAT) for authentication
environmentVariables.name: UNLEASH_PAT

environmentVariables.description: true or false to grant or deny send_feedback consent without a prompt
environmentVariables.name: UNLEASH_MCP_SEND_FEEDBACK

environmentVariables.description: Unleash instance that receives send_feedback reports. Unset, Unleash's instance (https://eu.app.unleash-hosted.com/hosted/).
environmentVariables.name: UNLEASH_FEEDBACK_URL

environmentVariables.description: Directory holding feedback_consent.json (defaults to the platform config directory)
environmentVariables.name: UNLEASH_MCP_CONFIG_DIR
